name: Microraptor (Zhaoianus)
label: Zhaoianus subspecies
title: Windgleiter
note: Born in Big Tree Overlook, Wind Tunnels, Cliff Edge Falls, Black Fern Hills, Volcano Islands and Stillwater Bog; able to glide for longer. Big Tree Overlook is also every subspecies' courtship ground. The subspecies is optional and only says where an individual hatched, so its range overlaps the others'. Shares the official Microraptor profile with the Gui and Hanqiugi subspecies.
